propositions: Diagnostic artifacts measuring completion-verifier runaway (diag-runaway-transcript.md, diag_runaway_transcript.py, diag_runaway_matrix.py) existed on branch impl-10ae-verifier-ctx (commit 556708771e) but were not ancestors of origin/main, making the ticket unverifiable.

The three diagnostic files have been landed on main as byte-identical copies (Gerrit 1498, commit 87b8023e31) following established docs/experiments/ convention for paired driver + findings documentation.

Budget-anchoring matrix confirms verifier step-floor scaling: floor 50 requires ~25 requests (0/3 runaway), floor 240 requires ~120 (2/2 runaway, recovered), floor 480 requires ~240 (3/3 runaway, recovered); flat _VERIFY_MIN_STEPS=480 provides ~10x surplus budget.

Completion-verifier runaway loops still reproduce on current main (measured 2026-08-07 post-merge): 4c2b and dbb2 closes triggered runaway guard at 66 requests; loop clusters on TEST-INFRASTRUCTURE tickets with multi-file criterion anchoring, suggesting context pre-selection as root cause.
